scenario: LCRS.6.2.3 — `as <expr>` is the trailing clause of every `call` action. A kwarg appearing after `as` is a parse error (DS_PARSE_GENERIC). Pin: `call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" as "k" cooldown: 30_s` rejects because `cooldown:` appears after `as`.
rules_ds:
service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" as "k" cooldown: 30_s
